facts: job fields: skills, model/provider, script (always a FILE under HERMES_HOME/scripts, never a command line; stdout injected into the prompt; no_agent=True makes the script the whole job), context_from, workdir (that directory's AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md loaded), deliver/failure_deliver, enabled_toolsets, attach_to_session, monitor_script/monitor_url, pinned/reasoning_effort

scheduler discipline: inactivity watchdog default 600s idle (HERMES_CRON_TIMEOUT override, 0=unlimited); script timeout default 3600s; catch-up window half period clamped 120s-2h and 120s one-shot grace; at-most-once accounting (next_run_at + pending_slot before dispatch); headless ticks refuse to spawn; cron sessions skip_memory=True and have their own session; optional mirrored briefs
cronjob_prompt_scan: strict threat scan of user prompts (skill bodies prose-proof)
reference.adaptation: V2 ScheduleValue already carries skills/context_from/continuity (+v0049) and cronjob_manage has additionalProperties=false with six actions.
